records.text: Owens said Emma Cooper established Empress Films in 2020 after serving as Pulse Films’ global president of non-scripted television and working on the Netflix series The Disappearance of Madeleine McCann.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: plus the founder of Empress Films, which is a woman named Emma Cooper. The company's relatively new, established in 2020. ... Their backstory is that Emma Cooper was previously the global president of non-scripted television at Pulse Films, where she worked on nonfiction films and series, and then following what was a massive global success of her hit Netflix documentary series, which was entitled The Disappearance of Maddie (Madeleine McCann). ... Madeleine McCann: extremely controversial disappearance, if you recall. A little girl, lots of conspiracy theories that went with that. Emma Cooper created then Empress Films, where she was going to chase basically making that the regular beat of the company: murder mystery. She's done a lot of work with murder mystery stuff in general, and now Empress Films was going to be like, that's our thing, murder mystery. I'm going to keep emphasizing that to you.
